tools.name: post_need
tools.description: Post a Need to the board. Argument: the full Need object (see /schemas/need.schema.json).

tools.name: list_needs
tools.description: List open, unexpired Needs. Optional capability filter.

tools.name: submit_bid
tools.description: Submit a Bid on an open Need. Arguments: need_id and the full Bid object.

tools.name: close_match
tools.description: Close a Match for a Need: runs the match engine over its bids, picks the winner, optionally verifies an escrow authorization on-chain.

tools.name: confirm_delivery
tools.description: Confirm delivery of a Match; triggers the escrow capture + 95/5 payout split when the match is escrow-backed.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "close_match" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Close a Match for a Need: runs the match engine over its bids, picks the winner, optionally verifies an escrow authorization on-chain.
